verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an official CLI at clerk.com/cli. It includes `clerk init`, which detects the framework, links an app and adds auth files. It also covers local webhook relay with offline signature verification, `clerk impersonate` for debugging, production deploy setup (domain, OAuth, DNS), and a one-command MCP connection to AI clients, which suits an AI-native workflow. The evidence is first-party marketing-page copy only. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, documentation of agent-friendly behavior such as machine-readable output or non-interactive mode.
